details: We have developed a Interactive Dashboard that summarize ranks, interprets, microgravity combustion, finding to deliver fire safety insights and also provides the details of the experiments done by NASA and other related queries. It can provide the information about the fire that can cause in the spaceship and helps in resolving that by providing the information about that. It address the challenge by centralizing experimental combustion data, intelligently summarizing key finding, ranking relevant insights and interpreting complex microgravity fire behavior into a user friendly interphase and also by providing the solutions for the question asked related to the topic. It is important because, as we are moving forward to research on Moon and Mars, this data is very important because it provides the information about the fire that can catch in the spaceship, which help us to solve those problems. We collected the data from the official NASA website and we selected some of the dataset which is related to our topic like BASS-I, II and III and SAFFIRE, FLEX etc... We used html and css for frontend and python for backend. we used flask website to combine both frontend and backend. We used Lovable dashboard builder to build our dashboard. We used Microsoft Power-point for preparing PPT. We hope that this project get selected and may all use and take the benefits of this dashboard.
